name: Ha Long Bay
provinceNote: Pages use both tỉnh Quảng Ninh and thành phố Quảng Ninh. From 1 July 2025 the old thành phố Hạ Long is not a district-level city. The wards are address lines inside this place.
summary: A bay of limestone towers you see from a boat. Take a day boat among the islands, stay overnight on the water, and kayak through a notch into a lake.
timeNeeded: A day boat, or a night aboard
getThere: Van Don airport, or the road from Hanoi.
bestMonths: Clear mornings. Check the flight in June–September.
seoTitle: Ha Long Bay travel guide — the boat, an overnight, and kayaking
seoDescription: A boat among the limestone towers, a night on the water, and a kayak into a lake. Route 1 is 3–4 hours. Route 2 is 5–6 hours.
intro: You come for a boat among the limestone towers, a night on the water, and a kayak through a notch into a lake. The property was inscribed in 1994, with boundary changes in 2000 and 2023. Island counts are given as 1,133 and as about 1,600. The Hạ Long Bay Management Board runs this side. Cát Bà is the other shore of the same property. Bái Tử Long is part of this water.

Leave from Cảng tàu khách quốc tế Hạ Long or from Tuần Châu. Route 1 is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang. Route 2 is 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn. The English port line is Beach road, New Beach, Bai Chay ward, 500 m from Sun World. Quốc lộ 18 crosses between the shores on Cầu Bãi Cháy.

Do not budget one all-in price. From 1 April 2024 the tourism notice lists a port passenger fee of 40,000 to 60,000 đồng a person. On that sentence, people 60 and over pay half, and children from 7 to 15 pay 20 percent less. Route 1 totals 440,000–460,000 đồng, split as 310,000 sightseeing and 150,000 boat. Route 2 totals 490,000–510,000 đồng, split as 310,000 and 200,000. Inside the 310,000, 60,000 is the port fee and 250,000 is the rest of that sentence. A heritage-board notice from 17 July 2023 gives free entry under 1.2 m or under 7, and to severely disabled people under the decree it cites, half price for Vietnamese citizens 60 and over, and 20 percent off from age 7 to under 16. The port sentence says 7 to 15. The board sentence says 7 to under 16. From 10 December 2025 a bay ticket needs an identity card or a passport.
gettingAround: The bay is a boat from the Hạ Long passenger port or from Tuần Châu. You do not drive the route. Cảng hàng không quốc tế Vân Đồn is the airport. The airport operator gives Doan Ket Commune, Van Don District, and Vietnam Airlines gives xã Đoàn Kết, huyện Vân Đồn. The civil aviation note says that commune at inauguration on 30 December 2018. Nghị quyết 1679 put the old Vân Đồn communes into đặc khu Vân Đồn. The airline page says about 50 km from thành phố Hạ Long and about 15 km from Cái Rồng. Runway figures are given as 3.6 km by 45 m with nearly 27,000 m² of terminal, and as a runway of 3,600 m with more than 27,000 m². Capacity is 2.5 million passengers. ICAO 4E, ILS Cat II. Buses 14A and 14B are about 3,000–10,000 đồng. Taxi is 11,000–13,000 đồng a kilometre, with a flag fall of 29,500 đồng for the first 2 km.

Cao tốc CT.06 is Hải Phòng–Hạ Long–Vân Đồn–Móng Cái. Km0 is at Hải An, meeting CT.04 at Km 104+740. The end is Km175+340 at Móng Cái. Hạ Long junctions are Minh Khai Km25+00, Việt Hưng Km30+510, and Đồng Lá Km56+880. The airport junction is Km88+800. The expressway investor says the Hạ Long–Vân Đồn section is nearly 60 km, design speed 100 km/h, and that Hanoi to Van Don fell from 5 hours to about 2.5 hours. That claim is the airport road, not a clock to the Bãi Cháy piers.

Cát Bà is the other shore of the same property since the 2023 boundary change. The 9 June 2024 article says the shortcut is about 7 km and about 200,000 đồng a guest for two ways. The same article names the ferry Tuần Châu–Gia Luận. It counts about 60 fast boats and tenders, and above 300,000 guests in 2022 and above 400,000 in 2023 through Cảng tàu du lịch quốc tế Tuần Châu. Many crossing boats pass Hòn Trống Mái and skip the other stops. Hải Phòng is the other province on the property and the start of CT.06.

stayAreas.name: Overnight on the bay
stayAreas.summary: Sleep on a boat when you want the towers after the day boats leave. Overnight averages 600,000–800,000 đồng a person. The notice does not name a boat or what the price includes.

eat: Chả mực Hạ Long is the plate: hot, with bánh cuốn, xôi trắng, or cơm, on the boats and on the Tết table. Bún bề bề and bún cù kỳ are the morning bowls. Sữa chua trân châu and bánh trôi tàu are the sweets. Rượu ngán is the drink with the seafood.

The seafood market under Núi Bài Thơ runs from 4:30 and is done before 7:00, on Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020. Friday and Saturday, phố đi bộ Bài Thơ runs 18:00–24:00 on Long Tiên and Lê Quý Đôn. Công luận also says holidays and Tết.
interestsBody: You come for the boat among the towers, then the two cave routes, Ti Tốp’s sand, and the hill over Cửa Lục.
Dining is the squid cake and the night streets. A night aboard is the stay. The cable car crosses Cửa Lục in the afternoon.

interestCards.title: The boat and the towers
interestCards.summary: Hòn Trống Mái from the deck. The port calls the pair the symbol of Hạ Long tourism.

interestCards.title: The two cave routes
interestCards.summary: Route 1 lands in Thiên Cung and Đầu Gỗ. Route 2 lands in Sửng Sốt and passes Luồn.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: Squid cake on the boats, then seafood on the Bãi Cháy night streets.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Chả mực, eaten hot with rice sheets, sticky rice, or rice. The night streets are in the food guide.

interestGroups.title: Resort Living
interestGroups.summary: A cabin after the day boats leave.

cards.title: Resort Living
cards.summary: Overnight on the bay averages 600,000–800,000 đồng a person. The notice does not name a boat.

interestGroups.title: The boat and the towers
interestGroups.summary: The day is a boat among the limestone, and the pair of rocks the port calls the symbol.

cards.title: Fighting Cock Islet
cards.summary: Hòn Trống Mái, seen from the boat.

interestGroups.title: The two cave routes
interestGroups.summary: The short boat lands in two caves. The long boat lands in Sửng Sốt and rows through Luồn.
body: Route 1 is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang. Ba Hang is three small notch caves that open onto two salt lakes. You kayak or take a rowboat.
The same boat passes Hòn Chó Đá and Hòn Đỉnh Hương. You look from the deck. The port does not say it stops. Route 2 is 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn together.

cards.title: Sung Sot Cave
cards.summary: On Bồ Hòn. The port calls it the widest yet found, 20 m above the sea.

cards.title: Thien Cung Cave
cards.summary: On đảo Đầu Gỗ. About 3,000 m², 20 m above the sea.

cards.title: Dau Go Cave
cards.summary: The same landing as Thiên Cung. The port calls it one of the earliest known caves.

cards.title: Luon Cave
cards.summary: You row or kayak through the notch into a lake.

interestGroups.title: Ti Top
interestGroups.summary: The only island in the bay that Hồ Chí Minh named, with a crescent of sand and a climb.

cards.title: Ti Top Island
cards.summary: Crescent sand, a swim, a kayak, and a climb. The clock is the 5–6 hour route.

interestGroups.title: Núi Bài Thơ
interestGroups.summary: A 106 m hill over Cửa Lục, with the pagoda and the temple at its foot.

blocks.heading: Chùa Long Tiên
paragraphs: At the foot of the hill. The cluster account says it was built in 1941 under the Nguyễn court, with a three-door gate, and that it shares the national ranking of Quyết định 1140-QĐ/BT on 31 August 1992. The festival is when Tết arrives.

blocks.heading: Đền Đức Ông
paragraphs: The temple of Trần Quốc Nghiễn, on the same hill and the same 1992 ranking. Three bays and a rear sanctuary, with Yết Kiêu and Giã Tượng in the side bays. The courtyard is 2,531.8 m² in a 2011 decision and 2,689.8 m² in a 2013 adjustment.

cards.title: Poem Mountain
cards.summary: The hill, the flag, and the bay. Ranked a national relic on 31 August 1992.

interestGroups.title: The museum
interestGroups.summary: The coal-block building on Trần Quốc Nghiễn, facing Cửa Lục.

cards.title: Quang Ninh Museum
cards.summary: More than 30,000 objects. Adult entry 40,000 đồng on the operator’s citation of the 2018 resolution.

interestGroups.title: The cable car over Cửa Lục
interestGroups.summary: The Queen cable car from Bãi Cháy to Ba Đèo, and the bridge you see from the cabin.

cards.title: Queen Cable Car
cards.summary: Ga Đại Dương to Ga Mặt Trời. The length is given as 2.2 km and as 2.222 km.

faqs.a: Route 1 is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang. Route 2 is 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn. Those clocks are the whole route. You kayak or row through Luồn and through Ba Hang.

faqs.q: What does the bay ticket cost?
faqs.a: The 15 March 2024 notice lists route 1 at 440,000–460,000 đồng and route 2 at 490,000–510,000, with a port fee of 40,000–60,000. A 2023 board notice uses a child age of 7 to under 16, while the port sentence says 7 to 15. From 10 December 2025 you need an identity card or a passport. Do not pay one blended price.

faqs.q: How do I get there from Hanoi?
faqs.a: The road is the usual way. The investor’s about 2.5 hours is Hanoi to Van Don, not the Bãi Cháy piers. Van Don airport is about 50 km from the old city address.
Bún bề bề and bún cù kỳ are the morning bowls, at the markets and at Bãi Cháy. Bún hải sản and cháo trai are morning too. Phở is the common breakfast in the center and at Bãi Cháy.

season.label: Clear mornings
season.note: June–September, Vietnam Airlines notes fog and heavy rain at Van Don and says to check the flight. Confirm the boat the day you sail. Carnaval has used the late-April and 1 May holiday. In 2026 the night was 18:30–22:30 on 30 April along Trần Quốc Nghiễn.
